findings.area: agenda row — Serie A, Juventus – Lazio (20:45, søndag)
findings.issue: The Juventus crest fails to render: the icon slot shows a plain outlined box (browser's default broken-image placeholder), not a club crest. Every neighboring row (Real Madrid, Udinese, Celta Vigo, etc.) renders its crest correctly, so this looks like a missing/broken image asset specific to Juventus rather than a general icon failure.

notes: Checked at 375/393/900px, dark theme, full-page plus scrolled close-up crops to read small text.

No horizontal scroll or clipped text at 375px; multi-word fixtures (e.g. 'Borussia Mönchengladbach – TSG Hoffenheim') wrap onto extra lines rather than truncating — full names stay readable, nothing hidden.
Channel column is consistently Norwegian (TV 2 Play, Viaplay, VG TV, NRK-adjacent, Twitch(Thunderpick) for esports) — no foreign broadcaster (FOX/ESPN/Sky) seen anywhere in the agenda.
Rows with no known channel show an honest faint '–' (e.g. several Bundesliga/Serie A fixtures) instead of guessing — matches the design intent.
Round-robin/odd sports (chess 'pågår nå', esports FURIA/Team Falcons, alpine Sölden, Formula 1 kvalifisering) all render cleanly with correct flags/icons and round/stage labels.

The floating 'Assistent' button overlaps mid-agenda rows at all three widths, as sanctioned by DESIGN.md — it never covers the last agenda/news row or the footer in any of the captured scroll positions, so no finding raised for it.

At 900px the layout stays a single centered column (not a grid), consistent with the calm-design max-640px rule; the Assistent button sits over mid-list content there too without hiding anything critical.
National flags (Norway on tennis/golf rows) and most club crests render crisply; only the one Juventus instance above was a broken image.
Footer line ('Dataene er ~3t gamle', AI-budsjett) and day headings are intact and aligned at all widths checked.
